title: Sieges of Gassantoda Castle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Sieges of Gassantoda Castle", at revision 1370746809, opens: "The sieges of Gassantoda Castle  were a series of 16th-century battles during the Sengoku period of Japan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5366700, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1542 first siege of Gassan Toda". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
